trial_sequence.value: Three randomized trial families: A, T and AT. Each T/AT trial contains three successive tactile events.

trial_families.value: Auditory-only A control, tactile-only T control, and multisensory AT.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: A: 3000-ms approaching white noise; T: three touches without sound; AT: same three touches with sound.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Nominal tactile events at 500, 1500 and 2500 ms; each delay jittered by 0-200 ms in 50-ms steps.

condition_intermixing.value: 85 trials of each A/T/AT family presented randomly.

trial_sequence.evidence_note: Three tactile events occur within each T/AT trial; do not expand them into three single-target trials.

task_response.value: Passive iEEG task: attend to sound and touch with eyes closed; no overt response requested.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: No behavioral detection or catch-response rule.

response_mode_or_device.value: No overt response device/task.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Attend to auditory and tactile stimulation while reclined, eyes closed.

response_window_and_anchor.value: Not applicable: electrophysiological acquisition without behavioral response deadline.

jitter_iti_policy.value: Tactile-delay jitter 0-200 ms in 50-ms steps; ITI randomly selected/shuffled among 1.4, 1.7 and 1.9 s.
jitter_iti_policy.page_or_section: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures

policy_type.value: Discrete tactile-event jitter plus discrete intertrial intervals.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: Each nominal tactile delay and interval between trials.

jitter_iti_policy.evidence_note: Selection probabilities and the exact ITI endpoint convention are not specified; do not silently assert uniform draws.

soa_schedule.value: Three tactile events per T/AT trial at nominal 500,1500,2500 ms; in AT these are relative to sound onset.
soa_schedule.page_or_section: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures

reference_event_and_sign.value: Trial onset for T; common trial/sound onset for AT.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: 500,1500,2500 ms, with 0-200-ms jitter in 50-ms steps.

soa_schedule.evidence_note: The source contains isolated m/ms typographic inconsistencies; the repeated ms statements and 3000-ms trial establish the millisecond schedule.
